purpose: Bound existing Frosty research coverage before the exhaustive multiplayer weapon and attachment audit.

capture.countMethod: Recursive file count under each capture/<name>/raw directory. For route comparison, relative routes had extensions removed and were lowercased.
capture.caveat: These are capture files/routes, not a complete game catalog. The capture manifest is partial.

repositoryEvidence.boundary: Selected findings; source scope explicitly says not a complete audit.
Tracked targets and discovery hints; not proof each target is audited.
Documents partial collection, export and decoder limits.
Field-specific semantics and confidence, not a complete field ledger.
Describes weapon/attachment source chains and scoped coverage.
Contains multiple targeted and some roster-wide passes; coverage is per named field.
Documents 5542 attachment records and selected branch/effect/generator coverage.
Works from reviewed attachment identities and site choices; reads active branches, mount slots, and equipment prerequisite IDs; unresolved mappings stop generation.

Selected global/shared operand tracing, not a complete consumer index.

weaponIdentityAndNames.notEstablished: Current-build exhaustive MP roster or mode availability.

weaponBlueprintWB.notEstablished: Every field, nested branch, array and reference for each included MP weapon.

weaponStatsGS.notEstablished: Complete field and selector/modifier reference ledger across all MP GS roots.

weaponAbilityBranches.notEstablished: Classification of every branch including hidden, disabled, gated or non-site branches.

attachmentRecordsAndEffects.notEstablished: Current MP eligibility per record or all effects/operands for every reachable attachment.

relationships: equipment prerequisite ID to attachment mapping
compatibilityAndPrerequisites.notEstablished: All non-site branches, uncaptured roots, or mode-gated choices.

globalOperands.notEstablished: Complete mapping of shared assets consumed by each MP weapon and branch.

nativeRuntime.notEstablished: Engine consumer meaning, activation and effective mode behavior where open questions remain.

rankedGaps.gap: Derive a current-build MP include/exclude roster from roots and identities; record evidence for cosmetic and proven SP/BR-only exclusions; retain uncertain entries.
rankedGaps.actionable: Compare candidate roots and referenced assets to the partial 1.4.3.0 raw trees and catalog. Mark uncaptured dependencies.

rankedGaps.gap: Create one source-backed field/reference row per included weapon GS and WB field, nested branch, array and external reference.
rankedGaps.actionable: Use captured raw assets; record exact path/hash and decode status. Preserve layout warnings.

rankedGaps.gap: Enumerate every included MP ability branch and cross-link progression, slot, kill switch, action, package, WB part and GS binding.
rankedGaps.actionable: Extend beyond site choices covered by compatibility generation.

rankedGaps.gap: Close attachment effects by eligibility and follow operands to WB inclusion and GS binding.
rankedGaps.actionable: Reuse existing handling/barrel/brake/optic/tooltip evidence as subfield coverage; flag unsupported effect classes.

rankedGaps.gap: Resolve dependency closure for included roots and classify missing targets as uncaptured, unresolved identity, or decoder limitation.
rankedGaps.actionable: Prioritize only references reachable from MP roots before broader catalog discovery.

limitations: The coverage inventory reports evidence found in existing repository artifacts. It does not assert absent source values where no pass is documented.
Counts of attachments or weapons in a named field pass do not imply complete field-level coverage.
Registry presence, strings, tags and source defaults alone do not prove multiplayer availability.
Raw captures overlap and are partial. Lack of a captured file is a collection gap, not evidence that an asset is nonexistent.
No raw assets, generated site data, scripts, or shared research files were changed by this coverage inventory.
